chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四(上)
chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits (part 1)

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 搜决神鬼总纲：论神司须凭官鬼；鬼空亡或不上卦决无鬼祟；鬼不空不拘衰旺动静皆作神司；发动或持世神力狷狂、犯宜急祷；先看鬼值五行、次察官临何六兽、再查病源缓急，便知何祟为殃

rule.yi: 以官鬼和动爻为主，以五行和六兽（六神）为凭。凡是论神灵的职司，必须凭官鬼，只要不逢旬空，或旺或衰都是作祟，只要出现在卦上，不论动静，一概按神仙来推。先看鬼落在哪一行，再察官鬼临的是哪个六兽，再查病的来源是缓是急，就知道是什么祟作怪。注说：如果占神灵的职司，要推官鬼；鬼如果空亡或不上卦，一定没有鬼祟，不可妄说；鬼如果不空，不论衰旺动静，都作为神灵的职司；如果发动或持世，神力狂暴，冒犯了应当赶快祷告；还要看鬼落在哪一爻、哪个六兽上，才说是什么鬼、什么神，六兽和五行列在后面。
rule.en: The Pressure line and the moving lines are the main lines, and the five phases and the six beasts (the six spirits) are the ground. In judging the offices of the spirits one must rely on the Pressure line; so long as it does not fall on Void, strong or weak it makes haunting, and so long as it appears in the hexagram, moving or still, it is in all cases reckoned as an immortal spirit. See first which phase the ghost falls on, then examine which of the six beasts the Pressure line sits on, then check whether the source of the illness is slow or urgent, and one knows what haunting is doing the harm. The commentary says: if divining the office of a spirit, work out the Pressure line; if the ghost is Void or absent from the hexagram, there is surely no haunting by a ghost, and one must not speak at random; if the ghost is not Void, whether weak or strong, moving or still, it stands for a spirit's office; if it moves or holds the Self, the spirit's power is fierce and wild, and if offended one should pray at once; look also at which line and which beast the ghost sits on, and only then say which ghost and which spirit; the six beasts and five phases are set out below.

zh: 以官鬼动爻为主，五行六兽为凭。
yi: 以官鬼和动爻为主，以五行和六兽为凭。
en: The Pressure line and the moving lines are the main lines, and the five phases and the six beasts are the ground.

zh: 凡论神司，须凭官鬼，
不值旬空或旺或衰皆作祟，
但临卦上若动若静，概为神仙推。
yi: 凡是论神灵的职司，必须凭官鬼，
只要不逢旬空，或旺或衰都是作祟，
只要出现在卦上，不论动静，一概按神仙来推。
en: In judging the offices of the spirits one must rely on the Pressure line;
so long as it does not fall on Void, strong or weak it makes haunting,
and so long as it appears in the hexagram, moving or still, it is in all cases reckoned as an immortal spirit.

zh: 鬼值五行，次察官临六兽，
再查病源缓急，便知何祟为殃。
yi: 先看鬼落在哪一行，再察官鬼临的是哪个六兽，
再查病的来源是缓是急，就知道是什么祟作怪。
en: See first which phase the ghost falls on, then examine which of the six beasts the Pressure line sits on,
then check whether the source of the illness is slow or urgent, and one knows what haunting is doing the harm.

zh: 若卜神司，当推官鬼，鬼若空亡及不上卦，决无鬼祟，不可妄言。
鬼若不空，不拘衰旺动静，皆作神司。
若发动或持世；
神力狷狂，犯宜急祷。
又看鬼临何爻何兽，方言何鬼何神，六兽五行开列于后。
yi: 如果占神灵的职司，要推官鬼；鬼如果空亡或不上卦，一定没有鬼祟，不可妄说。
鬼如果不空，不论衰旺动静，都作为神灵的职司。
如果发动或持世，
神力狂暴，冒犯了应当赶快祷告。
还要看鬼落在哪一爻、哪个六兽上，才说是什么鬼、什么神，六兽和五行列在后面。
en: If divining the office of a spirit, work out the Pressure line; if the ghost is Void or absent from the hexagram, there is surely no haunting by a ghost, and one must not speak at random.
If the ghost is not Void, whether weak or strong, moving or still, it stands for a spirit's office.
If it moves or holds the Self,
the spirit's power is fierce and wild, and if offended one should pray at once.
Look also at which line and which beast the ghost sits on, and only then say which ghost and which spirit; the six beasts and five phases are set out below.

note.yi: 这一章接在「还赛解厄」之前：病由鬼神作祟时，怎么认是哪一路。「六兽」就是六神（青龙、朱雀、勾陈、螣蛇、白虎、玄武），这一章都称六兽。第二句「概为神仙推」按字面译：出现在卦上的鬼一概当作神灵的职司来推，不分神、鬼。「神力狷狂，犯宜急祷」是说鬼发动或持世时，那位神的力量强，冒犯了要赶紧祈祷。这一章的办法和易冒的鬼神章（LY.ILL.YM.42 到 YM.64）、黄金策鬼神章（LY.ILL.HJC.93 到 HJC.120）是同一件事：用官鬼的五行、六神、卦宫、爻位去认神鬼；它比它们多出的是逐个五行配六神列出了具体的神名（下面 LY.ILL.EL.30 起）。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This chapter comes before 'thanksgiving rites to lift calamity' and shows how to tell which kind of ghost or spirit is at work when the illness is a haunting. The 'six beasts' are the six spirits (Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, Hook Earth, Coiling Snake, White Tiger, Dark Tortoise), which this chapter calls the six beasts throughout. The second sentence, 'in all cases reckoned as an immortal spirit', is translated literally: a ghost that appears in the hexagram is in all cases reckoned as the office of a spirit, without distinguishing spirit from ghost. 'The spirit's power is fierce and wild; if offended one should pray at once' means that when the ghost moves or holds the Self, that spirit's power is strong, and if offended one must pray quickly. The method is the same as the Yi Mao's chapter on ghosts and spirits (LY.ILL.YM.42 to YM.64) and the Huangjin Ce's (LY.ILL.HJC.93 to HJC.120): recognising ghosts and spirits by the phase, spirit, palace and line position of the Pressure line; what it adds is that it lists specific names of gods for each phase paired with each of the six spirits (from LY.ILL.EL.30). Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 金鬼配六兽：金为刀下之魂、喘咳横亡之鬼；症缓关公总管、症急丧部伤司；青龙关公、朱雀金都元帅（金元七）、勾陈螣蛇七煞土、白虎丧煞伤司、玄武曹堂水伤水道；退送则病体安康

rule.yi: 金鬼，是死在刀下的魂，喘咳、横死的鬼：症状缓的，是关公、总管；症状急的，是丧部、伤司。带青龙，是汉寿亭侯（关公）；朱雀，是金都元帅；勾陈、螣蛇，是七煞；白虎，是丧殃；玄武，是曹堂、西府。把它送走，病体就安康。注说：金鬼，主刀枪伤死的鬼、喘咳的鬼、横死的鬼；症状缓的，宜向关爷和总管祷告；病急的，必须酬谢丧煞和伤神；带青龙，是云长公（关公）有所妨碍；临朱雀，是金元七作祟为灾；带勾陈、螣蛇，是七煞土；带白虎，是丧煞和伤司；带玄武，是水伤、水道一类。
rule.en: Metal is the soul beneath the blade and the ghost of asthma-cough and violent death: if mild, Guan Gong and the Chief Official; if severe, the Mourning Department and the Injuring Office. With the Azure Dragon, the Marquis of Hanshou; the Vermilion Bird is the Golden Capital Marshal; Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake are the Seven Killings; the White Tiger is Mourning Calamity; the Dark Tortoise is the Cao Hall and the Western Bureau. Send it away, and the sick body is well. The commentary says: a Metal ghost governs ghosts of death by blade and spear, ghosts of asthma-cough and ghosts of violent death; if the symptoms are mild, pray to Lord Guan and the Chief Official; if the illness is urgent, one must make offering to the Mourning Killing and the Injuring spirit; with the Azure Dragon, it is an obstruction from Lord Yunchang; on the Vermilion Bird, Lord Jin Yuanqi is making the calamity; with Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, it is the Seven Killings Earth; with the White Tiger, it is the Mourning Killing and the Injuring Office; with the Dark Tortoise, it is the water injury and water-way sort.

zh: 金为刀下之魂，喘敕横亡之鬼，
缓则关公总管，急则丧部伤司，
青龙为汉寿亭侯。
朱雀乃金都元帅。
陈蛇云七煞，白虎曰丧殃。
玄武则曹堂西府。
退送，则病体安康。
yi: 金鬼，是死在刀下的魂，喘咳、横死的鬼：
症状缓的，是关公、总管；症状急的，是丧部、伤司。
带青龙，是汉寿亭侯。
朱雀，是金都元帅；
勾陈、螣蛇，是七煞；白虎，是丧殃；
玄武，是曹堂、西府。
把它送走，病体就安康。
en: Metal is the soul beneath the blade and the ghost of asthma-cough ('chi') and violent death:
if mild, Guan Gong and the Chief Official; if severe, the Mourning Department and the Injuring Office.
With the Azure Dragon, the Marquis of Hanshou;
the Vermilion Bird is the Golden Capital Marshal;
Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake are the Seven Killings; the White Tiger is Mourning Calamity;
the Dark Tortoise is the Cao Hall and the Western Bureau.
Send it away, and the sick body is well.

zh: 金鬼，土刀枪伤死鬼、喘敕鬼、横亡鬼，症之缓者，宜祷关爷并总管。
病之急者，必酬丧杀并伤神。
带青龙，则云长公之有碍。
临朱雀，相金元七之为灾。
带勾陈螣蛇，为七煞土。
带白虎，为丧煞及伤司。
带玄武，为水伤水道之类。
yi: 金鬼，主刀枪伤死的鬼、喘咳的鬼、横死的鬼；症状缓的，宜向关爷和总管祷告。
病急的，必须酬谢丧煞和伤神。
带青龙，是云长公（关公）有所妨碍。
临朱雀，是金元七作祟为灾。
带勾陈、螣蛇，是七煞土。
带白虎，是丧煞和伤司。
带玄武，是水伤、水道一类。
en: A Metal ghost governs ghosts of death by blade and spear, ghosts of asthma-cough and ghosts of violent death; if the symptoms are mild, pray to Lord Guan and the Chief Official.
If the illness is urgent, one must make offering to the Mourning Killing and the Injuring spirit.
With the Azure Dragon, it is an obstruction from Lord Yunchang.
On the Vermilion Bird, Lord Jin Yuanqi is making the calamity.
With Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, it is the Seven Killings Earth.
With the White Tiger, it is the Mourning Killing and the Injuring Office.
With the Dark Tortoise, it is the water injury and water-way sort.

note.yi: 这一节起，五行各一段：先是歌诀，再是解说。「喘敕」的「敕」不成词，像是「嗽」（咳）之误，这里译作喘咳，在英文里保留了「chi」的标记；解说第一句「土刀枪伤死鬼」的「土」按前后文应是「主」（下面木鬼、水鬼、火鬼、土鬼都是「主……鬼」），这里按「主」译。「汉寿亭侯」是关羽的封号（汉寿亭侯），「云长」是关羽的字，所以青龙带金鬼说的是关公；「关公」「关爷」「云长公」是同一位。「总管」是民间对某类地方神的统称，「丧部」「伤司」「曹堂」「西府」按字面译，书里没有解释。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: From this section there is one passage for each of the five phases: first a verse, then explanation. The 'chi' in 'asthma-cough (chi)' is not a word and looks like an error for 'cough' (sou), and it is rendered as asthma-cough with the 'chi' marked in the English; the 'tu' at the head of the first sentence of the explanation, 'tu blade-and-spear death ghosts', should by the context be 'zhu' (governs), as in the Wood, Water, Fire and Earth ghosts below, and it is translated as 'governs'. The Marquis of Hanshou is Guan Yu's title of enfeoffment and Yunchang is his style name, so the Azure Dragon on a Metal ghost speaks of Guan Gong; 'Guan Gong', 'Lord Guan' and 'Lord Yunchang' are one figure. 'Chief Official' is the popular collective name for a certain class of local god, and 'the Mourning Department', 'the Injuring Office', 'the Cao Hall' and 'the Western Bureau' are translated literally, the book not explaining them. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 木鬼配六兽：木为杖责之魂、疯疾悬梁之鬼；症缓山神五圣、症急东岳家堂；白虎伤司、青龙枷锁之愿与喜庆之神、勾陈九良星煞、螣蛇树圣山神、朱雀玄武草野三郎

rule.yi: 木鬼，是被杖责的魂，疯病、上吊的鬼：症状缓的，是山神、五圣；症状急的，是东兵（东岳）、家堂。白虎同在，就在门外酬谢伤神，用锣鼓追送；青龙同位，就在堂前酬还原愿，用笙萧；勾陈，是九良星煞；螣蛇，是树圣、山神；朱雀、玄武，是草野三郎，祭祀时要提防，灾非都落在你身上。注说：木鬼，主受刑责、戴枷锁的鬼、疯病鬼、上吊死的鬼；症状缓的，必是冒犯了山神、土地和五圣尊神；症状急的，必是干犯了东岳和家堂的众神；带白虎，赶快酬谢大小伤司；带青龙，宜酬还枷锁的愿，以及祷告喜庆的神；带勾陈，是冒犯了九良星；土带螣蛇，如果不是山神，一定是树上的神，又是作犯土；带朱雀或玄武，都是草野三郎。
rule.en: Wood is the soul of one beaten with the rod, the ghost of madness and of hanging from a beam: if mild, the Mountain God and the Five Sages; if severe, the Eastern Soldiers (the Eastern Peak) and the household shrine. With the White Tiger in the same place, thank the Injuring spirit outside the gate and send it off with gongs and drums; with the Azure Dragon in the same place, redeem the vow in front of the hall with pipes and flutes; Hook Earth is the Nine Good Stars and the killing stars; the Coiling Snake is the Tree Sage or Mountain God; the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise are the Third Lord of the wilds, and in sacrificing be careful, for calamity and blame will all fall on you. The commentary says: a Wood ghost governs ghosts of punishment, the cangue and fetters, ghosts of madness and ghosts of hanging; if the symptoms are mild, it is surely from offending the Mountain God, the Earth God and the honoured Five Sages; if urgent, surely from offending the Eastern Peak and the gods of the household shrine; with the White Tiger, quickly make offering to the greater and lesser Injuring Offices; with the Azure Dragon, redeem the vow of the cangue and pray to the spirits of festivity; with Hook Earth, there is an offence against the Nine Good Stars; Earth with the Coiling Snake, if not the Mountain God, must be the spirit in a tree, and is also the offence-making earth; with the Vermilion Bird or the Dark Tortoise, it is the Third Lord of the wilds.

zh: 木乃杖责之魂，疯疾悬梁之鬼，
缓则山神五圣，急则东兵家堂。
白虎同宫，门外谢伤追锣鼓。
青龙共位，堂前酬原品笙萧。
勾陈则九良星煞。
螣蛇则树圣山神。
雀武为草野三郎，祭虞必灾非统汝。
yi: 木鬼，是被杖责的魂，疯病、上吊的鬼：
症状缓的，是山神、五圣；症状急的，是东兵、家堂。
白虎同在，就在门外酬谢伤神，用锣鼓追送；
青龙同位，就在堂前酬还原愿，用笙萧；
勾陈，是九良星煞；
螣蛇，是树圣、山神；
朱雀、玄武，是草野三郎，祭祀时要提防，灾非都落在你身上。
en: Wood is the soul of one beaten with the rod, the ghost of madness and of hanging from a beam:
if mild, the Mountain God and the Five Sages; if severe, the Eastern Soldiers and the household shrine.
With the White Tiger in the same place, thank the Injuring spirit outside the gate and send it off with gongs and drums;
with the Azure Dragon in the same place, redeem the vow in front of the hall with pipes and flutes;
Hook Earth is the Nine Good Stars and the killing stars;
the Coiling Snake is the Tree Sage or Mountain God;
the Vermilion Bird and the Dark Tortoise are the Third Lord of the wilds, and in sacrificing be careful, for calamity and blame will all fall on you (the last phrase is obscure).

zh: 木鬼主刑责加析鬼、疯疾鬼、缢死鬼、症之缓者必犯山神土地及五圣尊神。
症之急者，必干东岳并家堂众神。
带白虎，速酬大小伤司。
带青龙，宜赛枷锁之原、及祷喜庆之神。
带勾陈有犯九良星。
土带螣蛇，若非山神，必是树上之神，又为作犯土。
带朱雀或带玄武，皆为草野三郎。
yi: 木鬼，主受刑责、戴枷锁的鬼、疯病鬼、上吊死的鬼；症状缓的，必是冒犯了山神、土地和五圣尊神。
症状急的，必是干犯了东岳和家堂的众神。
带白虎，赶快酬谢大小伤司。
带青龙，宜酬还枷锁的愿，以及祷告喜庆的神。
带勾陈，是冒犯了九良星。
土带螣蛇，如果不是山神，一定是树上的神，又是作犯土。
带朱雀或玄武，都是草野三郎。
en: A Wood ghost governs ghosts of punishment, the cangue and fetters, ghosts of madness and ghosts of hanging; if the symptoms are mild, it is surely from offending the Mountain God, the Earth God and the honoured Five Sages.
If urgent, surely from offending the Eastern Peak and the gods of the household shrine.
With the White Tiger, quickly make offering to the greater and lesser Injuring Offices.
With the Azure Dragon, redeem the vow of the cangue and pray to the spirits of festivity.
With Hook Earth, there is an offence against the Nine Good Stars.
Earth with the Coiling Snake, if not the Mountain God, must be the spirit in a tree, and is also the offence-making earth.
With the Vermilion Bird or the Dark Tortoise, it is the Third Lord of the wilds.

note.yi: 歌诀里的「东兵」和解说里的「东岳」应是同一位（东岳），歌诀字形可能有误，这里照字面译作「东兵」并在括号里标出；解说里「刑责加析鬼」的「加析」疑是「枷杻」（枷和手铐脚镣），按上下文译作枷锁。歌诀最后一句「祭虞必灾非统汝」原文很晦涩，「虞」和「统汝」都没有解释，这里按字面译，在英文里标了「意思不清」。「土带螣蛇」的「土」指鬼是土爻时，原文行文在木鬼一节里放了这一句，读法没有把握。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The 'Eastern Soldiers' in the verse and the 'Eastern Peak' in the explanation should be one figure (the Eastern Peak), the form in the verse being perhaps a slip, and it is translated literally as 'Eastern Soldiers' with the identification given in brackets; the 'jia xi' in 'ghosts of punishment, jia xi' in the explanation looks like 'jia niu' (the cangue and handcuffs and fetters) and is translated from the context as cangue and fetters. The last line of the verse, 'in sacrificing to Yu, calamity and blame all on you', is very obscure in the original, neither 'Yu' nor 'tong ru' being explained, and it is translated literally with a mark in the English that the meaning is unclear. 'Earth with the Coiling Snake' means the ghost being an Earth line; the original puts this sentence in the section on Wood ghosts, and the reading is uncertain. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 水鬼配六兽：水为投河奔井之魂、服卤腰疼之鬼；症缓水仙施相、症急河太金龙；阳龙云台法主萧公、阴龙南海慈尊杜氏、玄武佑圣真君、朱雀江河许愿、陈蛇坑厕、白虎水伤

rule.yi: 水鬼，是投河、奔井的魂，服卤、腰疼的鬼：症状缓的，是水仙、施相；症状急的，是河太、金龙。阳龙（阳的青龙），断作云台法主，也是冒犯了萧公；阴龙，推作南海慈尊，又冲犯了杜氏；玄武，是佑圣真君；朱雀，恐怕是对江河许过愿；遇到勾陈、螣蛇，断作坑厕；逢白虎，论作水伤。注说：水鬼，主淹死的鬼、腰疼的鬼、服卤死的鬼；症状缓的，是水仙五圣和镇海施相公；症状急的，是冒犯了水中的河太、或曹三和金龙四大王；阳鬼值青龙，是三官大帝和五圣的神；阴鬼值青龙，是观世音和杜氏夫人；鬼带玄武，是北极真君；带朱雀，是在水池上许的愿心；带勾陈或螣蛇，就说是水口上冒犯的；如果水鬼变出兄弟、或水的兄弟变出鬼、又带勾陈螣蛇的，就是坑厕的土神；鬼临白虎，必须向水部的伤司求。
rule.en: Water is the soul of one who threw himself into a river or ran to a well, the ghost of one who drank brine ('you' in the text, for 'lu') or of back pain: if mild, the Water Immortal and Minister Shi; if severe, He Tai and the Golden Dragon. A yang Dragon is judged the Master of the Yuntai Rite, and also offends Lord Xiao; a yin Dragon is worked out as the Compassionate Honoured One of the Southern Sea, and also clashes with Lady Du; the Dark Tortoise is the True Lord Yousheng; the Vermilion Bird: beware a vow made to river or lake; meeting Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, judge it the pit and privy; meeting the White Tiger, judge it the water injury. The commentary says: a Water ghost governs ghosts of drowning, ghosts of back pain and ghosts of death by drinking brine; if the symptoms are mild, it is the Water (the text says Fire) Immortal and the Five Sages, and the Sea-Pacifying Lord Shi; if urgent, it is an offence against He Tai in the water, or Cao San and the Golden Dragon Fourth Great King; a yang ghost on the Azure Dragon is the Three Officials the Great Emperors and the spirits of the Five Sages; a yin ghost on the Azure Dragon is Guanyin and Lady Du; a ghost with the Dark Tortoise is the True Lord of the North Pole; with the Vermilion Bird, a vow made by a pool; with Hook Earth or the Coiling Snake, say an offence at a water mouth; if the Water ghost changes into Peer, or a Water Peer changes into a ghost and carries Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, it is the earth spirit of the pit and privy; a ghost on the White Tiger must seek the Injuring Office of the Water Department.

zh: 水曰投河奔井之魂、服卣腰疼之鬼，
缓则水仙施相，急则河太金龙。
阳龙断云台法主、亦犯萧公。
阴龙推南海慈尊、又冲杜氏。
玄武为佑圣真君。
朱雀恐江河许原。
遇陈蛇断为坑厕。
逢白虎论作水伤。
yi: 水鬼，是投河、奔井的魂，服卤、腰疼的鬼：
症状缓的，是水仙、施相；症状急的，是河太、金龙。
阳龙断作云台法主，也是冒犯了萧公；
阴龙推作南海慈尊，又冲犯了杜氏；
玄武是佑圣真君；
朱雀，恐怕是对江河许过愿；
遇到勾陈、螣蛇，断作坑厕；
逢白虎，论作水伤。
en: Water is the soul of one who threw himself into a river or ran to a well, the ghost of one who drank brine ('you' in the text, for 'lu') or of back pain:
if mild, the Water Immortal and Minister Shi; if severe, He Tai and the Golden Dragon.
A yang Dragon is judged the Master of the Yuntai Rite, and also offends Lord Xiao;
a yin Dragon is worked out as the Compassionate Honoured One of the Southern Sea, and also clashes with Lady Du;
the Dark Tortoise is the True Lord Yousheng;
the Vermilion Bird: beware a vow made to river or lake;
meeting Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, judge it the pit and privy;
meeting the White Tiger, judge it the water injury.

zh: 水鬼主溺死鬼、腰疼鬼、服卣死鬼。
症之缓者，则为火仙五圣及镇海施相公。
症之急者，犯水中河太、或曹三并金龙四大王。
阳鬼值青龙，乃三官大帝及五圣之神。
阴鬼值青龙，为观世音及杜氏夫人。
鬼带玄武，为北极真君。
带朱雀，水池上许愿心。
带勾陈或螣蛇，便曰水口作犯上。
如水鬼化兄、或水兄化鬼又带陈蛇者，便是坑厕土神。
鬼临白虎，须求水部伤司。
yi: 水鬼，主淹死的鬼、腰疼的鬼、服卤死的鬼。
症状缓的，是火仙（疑是水仙）五圣和镇海施相公。
症状急的，是冒犯了水中的河太、或曹三和金龙四大王。
阳鬼值青龙，是三官大帝和五圣的神。
阴鬼值青龙，是观世音和杜氏夫人。
鬼带玄武，是北极真君。
带朱雀，是在水池上许的愿心。
带勾陈或螣蛇，就说是水口上冒犯的。
如果水鬼变出兄弟、或水的兄弟变出鬼、又带勾陈螣蛇的，就是坑厕的土神。
鬼临白虎，必须向水部的伤司求。
en: A Water ghost governs ghosts of drowning, ghosts of back pain and ghosts of death by drinking brine.
If the symptoms are mild, it is the Fire (probably Water) Immortal and the Five Sages, and the Sea-Pacifying Lord Shi.
If urgent, it is an offence against He Tai in the water, or Cao San and the Golden Dragon Fourth Great King.
A yang ghost on the Azure Dragon is the Three Officials the Great Emperors and the spirits of the Five Sages.
A yin ghost on the Azure Dragon is Guanyin and Lady Du.
A ghost with the Dark Tortoise is the True Lord of the North Pole.
With the Vermilion Bird, a vow made by a pool.
With Hook Earth or the Coiling Snake, say an offence at a water mouth.
If the Water ghost changes into Peer, or a Water Peer changes into a ghost and carries Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake, it is the earth spirit of the pit and privy.
A ghost on the White Tiger must seek the Injuring Office of the Water Department.

note.yi: 歌诀里「服卣」的「卣」应是「卤」（盐卤，自尽用的）之误，和易隐的「服卤」（LY.ILL.YY.28）一致；解说里「火仙五圣」的「火仙」疑是「水仙」之误（歌诀写的是水仙），这里按字面译并在括号里标出。「阳龙」「阴龙」是青龙临在阳爻或阴爻上；「陈蛇」是勾陈和螣蛇的合称。「河太」「曹三」「金龙四大王」是民间的河神，书里没有解释。三官大帝是天官、地官、水官。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The 'you' in 'drank you' in the verse should be 'lu' (salt brine, used to end one's life), agreeing with the Yi Yin's 'drank brine' (LY.ILL.YY.28); the 'Fire Immortal' in 'Fire Immortal and the Five Sages' in the explanation looks like an error for 'Water Immortal' (the verse writes Water Immortal), and it is translated literally with the doubt marked in brackets. A 'yang Dragon' and a 'yin Dragon' are the Azure Dragon on a yang or a yin line; 'Chen-she' is the joint name for Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake. 'He Tai', 'Cao San' and the 'Golden Dragon Fourth Great King' are popular river gods, and the book does not explain them. The Three Officials are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 火鬼配六兽：火为毒疮痨之魂、带血焚烧之鬼；症缓东厨香愿（灶神）、症急陆相华山（轻宜酬陆引即南堂、重宜拜华山即五福大神）；青龙五福、勾陈螣蛇三煞土、白虎赵玄坛与痴癫鬼、玄武南堂水神、朱雀华光司命（五显灵官、灶神）

rule.yi: 火鬼，是毒疮、痨病的魂，带血、焚烧的鬼：症状缓的，是东厨、香愿；症状急的，是陆相、华山。青龙，冒犯了五福星；勾陈、螣蛇，动了三煞的土；白虎，是玄坛再加上横死的鬼；玄武，是南堂和水神一起；朱雀，是华光、司命，并且酬还口愿才安宁。注说：火鬼，主疮毒鬼、痨病鬼、带血鬼、烧死的鬼、心疼的鬼；症状缓的，宜酬谢灶神和香愿；症状急的，也有轻重之分：轻病宜酬陆引，陆相就是南堂；重病宜拜华山，华山就是五福大神；带青龙也是五福；带勾陈或螣蛇都是三煞土；带白虎是赵玄坛和痴癫鬼；带玄武是南堂和水神；带朱雀是华光，华光就是五显灵官，又是司命，就是灶神。
rule.en: Fire is the soul of poisonous sores and consumption, the ghost of bleeding and of burning: if mild, the Eastern Kitchen and the incense vow; if severe, Minister Lu and Huashan. The Azure Dragon offends the Five Blessings star; Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake move the earth of the Three Killings; the White Tiger, the Dark Altar, and a violent-death ghost added; the Dark Tortoise, the Southern Hall and the water spirit together; the Vermilion Bird, Huaguang and the Director of Fate, and the spoken vow redeemed, then there is peace. The commentary says: a Fire ghost governs ghosts of sores and poison, ghosts of consumption, ghosts of bleeding, ghosts of burning to death and ghosts of heart pain; if the symptoms are mild, thank the Kitchen God and the incense vow; if urgent, there are still degrees: a light illness suits an offering to Lu Yin, Minister Lu being the Southern Hall; a heavy illness suits worship at Huashan, Huashan being the Great God of the Five Blessings; with the Azure Dragon it is also the Five Blessings; with Hook Earth or the Coiling Snake it is the Three Killings Earth; with the White Tiger it is Zhao Xuantan and a ghost of madness; with the Dark Tortoise it is the Southern Hall and a water spirit; with the Vermilion Bird it is Huaguang, and Huaguang is the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and also the Director of Fate, who is the Kitchen God.

zh: 火是毒疮痨之魂，带血焚烧之鬼，
缓则东厨香愿，急则陆相华山。
青龙犯五福之星，
陈蛇动三煞之土，
白虎玄坛加横鬼。
玄武南堂共水神。
朱雀华光司命并酬口原方宁。
yi: 火鬼，是毒疮、痨病的魂，带血、焚烧的鬼：
症状缓的，是东厨、香愿；症状急的，是陆相、华山。
青龙，冒犯了五福星；
勾陈、螣蛇，动了三煞的土；
白虎，是玄坛再加上横死的鬼；
玄武，是南堂和水神一起；
朱雀，是华光、司命，并且酬还口愿才安宁。
en: Fire is the soul of poisonous sores and consumption, the ghost of bleeding and of burning:
if mild, the Eastern Kitchen and the incense vow; if severe, Minister Lu and Huashan.
The Azure Dragon offends the Five Blessings star;
Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake move the earth of the Three Killings;
the White Tiger, the Dark Altar, and a violent-death ghost added;
the Dark Tortoise, the Southern Hall and the water spirit together;
the Vermilion Bird, Huaguang and the Director of Fate, and the spoken vow redeemed, then there is peace.

zh: 火鬼主疮毒鬼、痨怯鬼、带血鬼、烧死鬼、心疼鬼、症之缓者，宜谢灶神并香愿。
症之急者，亦有轻重之分：轻病宜酬陆引，陆相即是南堂；
重病宜拜华山，华山即五福大神。
带青龙亦为五福。
带勾陈或螣蛇皆为三煞土。
带白虎为赵玄坛及痴癫鬼。
带玄武为南堂及水神。
带朱雀为华光，华光乃五显灵官，又为司命，即是灶神。
yi: 火鬼，主疮毒鬼、痨病鬼、带血鬼、烧死的鬼、心疼的鬼；症状缓的，宜酬谢灶神和香愿。
症状急的，也有轻重之分：轻病宜酬陆引，陆相就是南堂；
重病宜拜华山，华山就是五福大神。
带青龙也是五福。
带勾陈或螣蛇都是三煞土。
带白虎是赵玄坛和痴癫鬼。
带玄武是南堂和水神。
带朱雀是华光，华光就是五显灵官，又是司命，就是灶神。
en: A Fire ghost governs ghosts of sores and poison, ghosts of consumption, ghosts of bleeding, ghosts of burning to death and ghosts of heart pain; if the symptoms are mild, thank the Kitchen God and the incense vow.
If urgent, there are still degrees: a light illness suits an offering to Lu Yin, Minister Lu being the Southern Hall;
a heavy illness suits worship at Huashan, Huashan being the Great God of the Five Blessings.
With the Azure Dragon it is also the Five Blessings.
With Hook Earth or the Coiling Snake it is the Three Killings Earth.
With the White Tiger it is Zhao Xuantan and a ghost of madness.
With the Dark Tortoise it is the Southern Hall and a water spirit.
With the Vermilion Bird it is Huaguang, and Huaguang is the Five Manifest Spirit Officials and also the Director of Fate, who is the Kitchen God.

note.yi: 歌诀的「陈蛇」是勾陈和螣蛇。「玄坛」「赵玄坛」是同一位（玄坛，财神一类），歌诀里的「元坛」是避讳写法；「陆引」「陆相」「南堂」被解说等同起来，「华山」「五福大神」也被等同，「华光」「五显灵官」「司命」「灶神」被解说连成一串。这几条等同都是书里自己说的，这里照译，没有另外核对。解说里「轻病」与「重病」的分法，是火鬼一节独有的：症急的再分轻重。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: 'Chen-she' in the verse is Hook Earth and the Coiling Snake. 'Xuantan' and 'Zhao Xuantan' are one figure (the Dark Altar, of the wealth-god kind), and the 'Yuan Altar' in the verse is the taboo-avoiding form; 'Lu Yin', 'Minister Lu' and 'the Southern Hall' are identified with one another in the explanation, 'Huashan' and 'the Great God of the Five Blessings' are identified, and 'Huaguang', 'the Five Manifest Spirit Officials', 'the Director of Fate' and 'the Kitchen God' are strung together by the explanation. These identifications are the book's own and are translated as they stand, without independent checking. The division of 'light illness' and 'heavy illness' in the explanation is peculiar to the section on Fire ghosts: an urgent illness is divided again by weight. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 土鬼配六兽：土为瘟疫之魂、膨胀虚黄之鬼；症缓庙神土府、症急贤圣城隍；青龙素土、勾陈土皇、白虎金神七煞、玄武坑厕、螣蛇作犯与本境之神、朱雀天曹与飞游之土；乾兑二卦或带天咒地咒负结煞亦为天曹土

rule.yi: 土鬼，是瘟疫的魂，膨胀、虚黄的鬼：症状缓的，是庙神、土府；症状急的，是贤圣、城隍。青龙，是素土；勾陈，叫土皇；白虎，是金神，忌它；玄武，是坑厕的妨害；螣蛇，应当作犯，并且求本境的神；朱雀，合于天曹，并且谢飞游的土。注说：土鬼，主瘟疫鬼、膨胀鬼、黄病鬼；症状缓的，是庙里的神、大的是土神；症状急的，是五方贤圣、又是城隍；带青龙，是正土，宜念素诰；带勾陈，是土皇，宜中奏；带白虎，是金神，就是七煞；带玄武，是水口上的作犯，如果鬼变出兄弟、或兄弟变出鬼，就是坑厕；土带螣蛇是作犯，土又是螣蛇，也是当地的杀神祠；带朱雀是飞土；如果在乾、兑两卦，就是天曹；即使不在乾、兑卦中，如果带天咒、地咒或负结煞，也是天曹土。天咒煞说：正月二月鼠来，三月四月酉，五月六月马头，七月猴走，八月鸡，九月犬，十月逢猪，子、兔、丑、鼠，是天咒；地咒煞从正月起在卯上顺行十二位；负结煞说：正月二月猪亏，三月四月牛，五月六月其星向兔游，七月八月蛇宫，九月十月未，十一月十二月酉中求。
rule.en: Earth is the soul of epidemic, the ghost of swelling and pale-yellow emptiness: if mild, the temple gods and the earth mansion; if severe, the sages and the City God. The Azure Dragon is the plain Earth; Hook Earth is called the Earth Emperor; the White Tiger is the Golden Spirit, which is to be avoided; the Dark Tortoise is the hindrance of the pit and privy; the Coiling Snake should be the offence-maker, and one seeks the god of the local region; the Vermilion Bird accords with the Heavenly Bureau, and one thanks the Flying-Wandering Earth. The commentary says: an Earth ghost governs ghosts of epidemic, ghosts of swelling and ghosts of jaundice; if the symptoms are mild, it is a god within a temple, or an earth god of greater rank; if urgent, it is the sages of the five quarters and also the City God; with the Azure Dragon, it is the right Earth, and a plain prayer is suitable; with Hook Earth, it is the Earth Emperor, and a central memorial is suitable; with the White Tiger, it is the Golden Spirit, that is, the Seven Killings; with the Dark Tortoise, it is an offence at a water mouth, and if the ghost changes into Peer or Peer changes into a ghost, it is the pit and privy; Earth with the Coiling Snake is the offence-maker, and Earth is also the Coiling Snake, which is also the local killing-god shrine; with the Vermilion Bird it is the flying earth; if it is in the Qian or Dui hexagram it is the Heavenly Bureau, and even if it is not in Qian or Dui, if it carries the Heavenly Curse, the Earth Curse or the Burden-Knot killing it is also the Heavenly Bureau earth. The Heavenly Curse killing says: 'in the first and second months the Rat comes, third and fourth the You, fifth and sixth the Horse's head, seventh the Monkey runs, eighth the Rooster, ninth the Dog, tenth meets the Pig, Zi, Rabbit, Chou, Rat': this is the Heavenly Curse; the Earth Curse killing runs forward twelve places from Mao in the first month; the Burden-Knot killing says: 'first and second the Pig is deficient, third and fourth the Ox, fifth and sixth its star wanders toward the Rabbit, seventh and eighth the Snake's palace, ninth and tenth Wei, eleventh and twelfth seek in You'.

zh: 土言瘟疫之魂、膨胀虚黄之鬼，
缓则庙神土府，
急则贤圣城隍。
青龙为素土，
勾陈曰土皇，
白虎金神忌，
玄武坑厕妨，
螣蛇当作犯兼求本境之神，
朱雀合天曹并谢飞游之土。
yi: 土鬼，是瘟疫的魂，膨胀、虚黄的鬼：
症状缓的，是庙神、土府；
症状急的，是贤圣、城隍。
青龙，是素土；
勾陈，叫土皇；
白虎，是金神，忌它；
玄武，是坑厕的妨害；
螣蛇，应当作犯，并且求本境的神；
朱雀，合于天曹，并且谢飞游的土。
en: Earth is the soul of epidemic, the ghost of swelling and pale-yellow emptiness:
if mild, the temple gods and the earth mansion;
if severe, the sages and the City God.
The Azure Dragon is the plain Earth;
Hook Earth is called the Earth Emperor;
the White Tiger is the Golden Spirit, which is to be avoided;
the Dark Tortoise is the hindrance of the pit and privy;
the Coiling Snake should be the offence-maker, and one seeks the god of the local region;
the Vermilion Bird accords with the Heavenly Bureau, and one thanks the Flying-Wandering Earth.

zh: 土鬼主瘟疫鬼、膨胀鬼、黄病鬼，症之缓者，为庙内之神、大为土神。
症之急者，为五方贤圣、又为城隍。
带青龙为正上宜素诰。
带勾陈为土皇，却宜中奏。
带白虎为金神，即七煞上带玄武为水口作犯上，若鬼化兄、或兄化鬼，便为坑厕。
土带螣蛇为作犯，土又为螣蛇上亦为当方上杀神祠。
带朱雀为飞土。
若在乾兑二卦，便作天曹，纵不在乾兑卦中，如带天咒或地咒或负结煞亦是天曹土，天咒煞云：正二鼠来三四酉，五六马头七猴走八鸡九犬，十逢猪子兔丑鼠，为天咒。
地咒煞正月从卯上顺行十二位，负结煞云：正二猪亏三四牛，五六其星向兔游，七八蛇宫九十未，十一十二酉中求。
yi: 土鬼，主瘟疫鬼、膨胀鬼、黄病鬼；症状缓的，是庙里的神、大的是土神。
症状急的，是五方贤圣、又是城隍。
带青龙，是正土，宜念素诰。
带勾陈，是土皇，宜中奏。
带白虎，是金神，就是七煞；带玄武，是水口上的作犯，如果鬼变出兄弟、或兄弟变出鬼，就是坑厕。
土带螣蛇是作犯，土又是螣蛇，也是当地的杀神祠。
带朱雀是飞土。
如果在乾、兑两卦，就是天曹；即使不在乾、兑卦中，如果带天咒、地咒或负结煞，也是天曹土。天咒煞说：正月二月鼠来，三月四月酉，五月六月马头，七月猴走，八月鸡，九月犬，十月逢猪，子、兔、丑、鼠，是天咒。
地咒煞从正月起在卯上顺行十二位；负结煞说：正月二月猪亏，三月四月牛，五月六月其星向兔游，七月八月蛇宫，九月十月未，十一月十二月酉中求。
en: An Earth ghost governs ghosts of epidemic, ghosts of swelling and ghosts of jaundice; if the symptoms are mild, it is a god within a temple, or an earth god of greater rank.
If urgent, it is the sages of the five quarters and also the City God.
With the Azure Dragon, it is the right Earth, and a plain prayer is suitable.
With Hook Earth, it is the Earth Emperor, and a central memorial is suitable.

With the White Tiger, it is the Golden Spirit, that is, the Seven Killings; with the Dark Tortoise, it is an offence at a water mouth, and if the ghost changes into Peer or Peer changes into a ghost, it is the pit and privy.
Earth with the Coiling Snake is the offence-maker, and Earth is also the Coiling Snake, which is also the local killing-god shrine.
With the Vermilion Bird it is the flying earth.

If it is in the Qian or Dui hexagram it is the Heavenly Bureau, and even if it is not in Qian or Dui, if it carries the Heavenly Curse, the Earth Curse or the Burden-Knot killing it is also the Heavenly Bureau earth. The Heavenly Curse killing says: 'in the first and second months the Rat comes, third and fourth the You, fifth and sixth the Horse's head, seventh the Monkey runs, eighth the Rooster, ninth the Dog, tenth meets the Pig, Zi, Rabbit, Chou, Rat': this is the Heavenly Curse.

The Earth Curse killing runs forward twelve places from Mao in the first month; the Burden-Knot killing says: 'first and second the Pig is deficient, third and fourth the Ox, fifth and sixth its star wanders toward the Rabbit, seventh and eighth the Snake's palace, ninth and tenth Wei, eleventh and twelfth seek in You'.

note.yi: 这一段里的三个咒煞口诀（天咒、地咒、负结），文字明显有讹脱（如「十逢猪子兔丑鼠」一句不合月份次序），这里照字面译，没有替它排出月份对照表。「素诰」是素食斋戒的诰文，「中奏」是向上奏告的一种仪式，「飞游土」「作犯土」「金神七煞」「天曹土」都是土部的神煞名（见易冒 LY.ILL.YM.48 里土部的称呼）。「土带螣蛇为作犯，土又为螣蛇上亦为当方上杀神祠」这一句文字不顺，读法没有把握。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地（苕溪一带）的民间神祇和星煞，书里一个也没有解释（章末自己说别的郡的神司不同），这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The three formulas for the curse killings (Heavenly Curse, Earth Curse, Burden-Knot) in this passage are plainly corrupt in places (for instance 'tenth meets the Pig, Zi, Rabbit, Chou, Rat' does not fit the order of the months), and they are translated literally, without drawing up a table of months. 'Plain prayer' is a text of fasting and vegetarian devotion, and 'central memorial' is a kind of rite of reporting upward; 'the Flying-Wandering Earth', 'the offence-making earth', 'the Golden Spirit and Seven Killings' and 'the Heavenly Bureau earth' are all names of earth stars and spirits (see the titles of the Earth department in the Yi Mao, LY.ILL.YM.48). 'Earth with the Coiling Snake is the offence-maker, and Earth is also the Coiling Snake, which is also the local killing-god shrine' does not run smoothly, and the reading is uncertain. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain (the book itself says at the end of the chapter that the gods of other prefectures differ), and none is identified here beyond what the book says.
